# B2 Reference Architectures for Generative Video

> Reference architectures, third-party integrations, and B2 sample applications for curating video training corpora, training video diffusion models, running generation farms and hosted generation pipelines with provenance, moderating, finishing, and delivering generated video with Backblaze B2.

Canonical Backblaze product documentation: https://www.backblaze.com/docs/cloud-storage-ai-machine-learning. Use this index to select an architecture, integration configuration, or sample application.

## Start here

- [Generative video summary](docs/gen-video.md): Concise workload and capability overview.
- [Architecture index](docs/architecture-index.md): Human-readable index generated from the catalog.
- [Machine-readable catalog](catalog/architectures.yaml): Audiences, workflows, capabilities, integrations, security, and compliance.
- [Full text](llms-full.txt): Summary and every architecture in one file.

## Architectures

- [Ingest licensed footage, then split, caption and curate a text-to-video training corpus](architectures/curate-video-training-corpus/architecture.md): Licensed source video lands in an immutable raw bucket; curation engines split, score, filter, dedupe and caption it over the S3 API and write clips, captions, scores and embeddings back under run-addressed prefixes so each dataset version traces to the run that produced it.
- [Stream video shards into distributed diffusion training and version checkpoints and LoRAs](architectures/stream-shards-train-video-diffusion/architecture.md): Curated clips or precomputed latents are packed into immutable versioned shards that stream from B2 into multi-node GPU training; checkpoints, LoRAs, samples and eval metrics return to B2 so preempted jobs resume, and approved weights are promoted to a model prefix for inference.
- [Run a self-hosted open-weight video diffusion farm with shared weights and outputs](architectures/self-hosted-video-diffusion-farm/architecture.md): Ephemeral ComfyUI GPU workers pull shared video diffusion checkpoints, VAEs and LoRAs from a model bucket with ETag-validated caching, render clips, and save outputs with the workflow JSON and seed to a generation prefix, returning presigned sharing URLs.
- [Generate video across hosted model APIs and keep every output with a provenance manifest](architectures/hosted-multi-provider-generation-provenance/architecture.md): A prompt becomes a storyboard and keyframes that fan out to hosted text-to-video and image-to-video APIs; every intermediate and final asset is copied into B2 before the provider URL expires, with a per-run manifest of SHA-256 hashes, provider, model, prompt, params, seed and parent_run_id.
- [Moderate, review and approve generated video before it is published](architectures/moderate-review-approve-generated-video/architecture.md): New clips land in a staging prefix; a B2 Event Notification triggers safety classification and a manifest hash check, editors review in a MAM connected to the same bucket, approved masters are copied to a published location, flagged assets move to quarantine, and disputed assets go under legal hold.
- [Finish, transcode and deliver generated video through a CDN](architectures/finish-package-deliver-generated-video/architecture.md): Approved generations get finishing passes (upscale, interpolation, matting, captions, cutdowns) recorded in job manifests, are transcoded to HLS ladders, posters and WebVTT, and are served from B2 through a CDN partner or a signing edge app; managed video platforms ingest masters from presigned URLs.

## Third-party integrations

- [rclone](https://rclone.org/): Built-in Backblaze B2 option. Configure a `b2` remote with a scoped application key (native B2 API); the S3 backend with provider Other and endpoint https://s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com also works ([setup guide](https://rclone.org/b2/)). Architecture: architectures/curate-video-training-corpus/architecture.md
- [video2dataset](https://github.com/iejMac/video2dataset): fsspec / s3fs. Set output_folder to s3://<bucket>/<prefix> and configure the fsspec s3 endpoint_url under client_kwargs as https://s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com. Architecture: architectures/curate-video-training-corpus/architecture.md
- [NVIDIA Cosmos Curator](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cosmos-curator): S3 custom endpoint. Configure the B2 profile in ~/.aws/credentials with aws_access_key_id, aws_secret_access_key, region and endpoint_url = https://s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com; Cosmos Curator reads only that file, not ~/.aws/config ([setup guide](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cosmos-curator/blob/main/docs/client/end-user-guide.md)). Architecture: architectures/curate-video-training-corpus/architecture.md
- [Daft](https://www.daft.ai/): S3 custom endpoint. Pass IOConfig(s3=S3Config(endpoint_url="https://s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com", region_name="<region>", key_id=..., access_key=...)) to reads and writes ([setup guide](https://docs.daft.ai/en/stable/api/config/)). Architecture: architectures/curate-video-training-corpus/architecture.md
- [Pixeltable](https://pixeltable.com/): Built-in Backblaze B2 option. Add a [b2] profile with the application key to ~/.aws/credentials, set b2_profile = "b2" in config.toml, and point media destinations at https://s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com/<bucket>/<prefix>/ ([setup guide](https://docs.pixeltable.com/integrations/cloud-storage)). Architecture: architectures/curate-video-training-corpus/architecture.md
- [LanceDB / Lance](https://lancedb.com/): S3 custom endpoint. Use the pinned LanceDB 0.20.0 / pylance 0.23.2 connection profile in examples/lancedb.md, with the B2 endpoint, region and scoped credentials; serialize all table mutations through one writer service ([setup guide](https://github.com/lance-format/lance/blob/v0.23.2/rust/lance-table/src/io/commit.rs)). Architecture: architectures/curate-video-training-corpus/architecture.md
- [MosaicML Streaming](https://github.com/mosaicml/streaming): S3 custom endpoint. Set S3_ENDPOINT_URL to https://s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com and the application key as AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY ([setup guide](https://docs.mosaicml.com/projects/streaming/en/stable/how_to_guides/configure_cloud_storage_credentials.html)). Architecture: architectures/stream-shards-train-video-diffusion/architecture.md
- [Lightning LitData](https://github.com/Lightning-AI/litData): S3 custom endpoint. Pass storage_options with S3_ENDPOINT_URL (or the boto3 endpoint_url) set to https://s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com to both optimize and StreamingDataset. Architecture: architectures/stream-shards-train-video-diffusion/architecture.md
- [Ray Train](https://docs.ray.io/): S3 custom endpoint. Set storage_path to s3://<bucket>/<path>?endpoint_override=https://s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com, or set AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3 with the application key in AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, per the guide's Backblaze B2 section ([setup guide](https://docs.ray.io/en/latest/train/user-guides/persistent-storage.html)). Architecture: architectures/stream-shards-train-video-diffusion/architecture.md
- [MosaicML Composer checkpointing](https://docs.mosaicml.com/projects/composer/en/stable/trainer/checkpointing.html): S3 custom endpoint. Set S3_ENDPOINT_URL to https://s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com and use s3:// save_folder and load_path; Composer writes locally, uploads, and resumes from B2. Architecture: architectures/stream-shards-train-video-diffusion/architecture.md
- [MLflow](https://mlflow.org/): Built-in Backblaze B2 option. Set the artifact root to b2://<bucket>@s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com/<path> with the application key in AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY and AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=<region>; s3:// with MLFLOW_S3_ENDPOINT_URL also works ([setup guide](https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/self-hosting/architecture/artifact-store/)). Architecture: architectures/stream-shards-train-video-diffusion/architecture.md
- [ZenML](https://www.zenml.io/): Built-in Backblaze B2 option. Run zenml integration install b2 and register an artifact store with --flavor=b2, an s3:// path and client_kwargs endpoint_url for the bucket region; credentials come from B2_APPLICATION_KEY_ID / B2_APPLICATION_KEY or a ZenML secret ([setup guide](https://docs.zenml.io/stacks/stack-components/artifact-stores/b2)). Architecture: architectures/stream-shards-train-video-diffusion/architecture.md
- [Weights & Biases reference artifacts](https://wandb.ai/): S3 custom endpoint. Set AWS_S3_ENDPOINT_URL to https://s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com and log s3:// reference artifacts; the reference-artifact docs list Backblaze B2 with this endpoint ([setup guide](https://docs.coreweave.com/guides/artifacts/track-external-files/)). Architecture: architectures/stream-shards-train-video-diffusion/architecture.md
- [ComfyUI Cloud Storage nodes](https://github.com/backblaze-labs/comfyui-cloud-storage): Built-in Backblaze B2 option. Built-in Backblaze B2 provider preset via COMFY_S3_PROVIDER and COMFY_S3_REGION; COMFY_S3_ENDPOINT_URL overrides. Architecture: architectures/self-hosted-video-diffusion-farm/architecture.md
- [HF Cache Sync](https://github.com/backblaze-labs/hf-cache-sync): Built-in Backblaze B2 option. Set B2_ENDPOINT, B2_BUCKET, B2_REGION, B2_APPLICATION_KEY_ID and B2_APPLICATION_KEY (or storage.* in .hf-cache-sync.yaml); hf-cache-sync doctor shows which source it used. Architecture: architectures/self-hosted-video-diffusion-farm/architecture.md
- [Runway API](https://docs.dev.runwayml.com/): Application worker. Relay inputs from B2 through Runway's upload API (POST /v1/uploads, 512 bytes to 200 MB, runway:// URI valid 24 h), then copy generation outputs into B2 with a provenance manifest. Alternatively supply a public or CDN input URL that answers HEAD; a presigned GET URL is signed for GET only ([setup guide](https://docs.dev.runwayml.com/assets/uploads/)). Architecture: architectures/hosted-multi-provider-generation-provenance/architecture.md
- [Replicate](https://replicate.com/): Presigned URLs. Pass a B2 presigned GET URL as the file input; copy outputs into B2 within one hour, because Replicate deletes API outputs after that by default ([setup guide](https://replicate.com/docs/topics/predictions/input-files)). Architecture: architectures/hosted-multi-provider-generation-provenance/architecture.md
- [iconik (Backlight)](https://www.iconik.io/): Built-in Backblaze B2 option. Native "Backblaze B2" storage type configured with keyID, applicationKey, bucket name, bucket ID and path; enable Scan to generate proxies. One storage per prefix-scoped key (inbox/staging/, published/) ([setup guide](https://www.backblaze.com/docs/cloud-storage-integrate-iconik-with-backblaze-b2)). Architecture: architectures/moderate-review-approve-generated-video/architecture.md
- [EditShare FLOW](https://www.editshare.com/): Built-in Backblaze B2 option. Native "Backblaze" storage type configured with keyID, applicationKey and bucket name ([setup guide](https://www.backblaze.com/docs/cloud-storage-integrate-editshare-flow-with-backblaze-b2)). Architecture: architectures/moderate-review-approve-generated-video/architecture.md
- [Cloudflare CDN / Workers](https://www.cloudflare.com/): CDN origin. Public bucket as origin, or a Worker that signs requests to a private bucket with a scoped B2 application key ([setup guide](https://www.backblaze.com/docs/cloud-storage-deliver-private-backblaze-b2-content-through-cloudflare-cdn)). Architecture: architectures/finish-package-deliver-generated-video/architecture.md
- [bunny.net CDN](https://bunny.net/): CDN origin. Pull-zone origin is the B2 S3 endpoint; S3 Authentication with a keyID and applicationKey for private buckets ([setup guide](https://www.backblaze.com/docs/cloud-storage-integrate-bunnynet-with-backblaze-b2)). Architecture: architectures/finish-package-deliver-generated-video/architecture.md
- [Fastly](https://www.fastly.com/): CDN origin. B2 S3 endpoint as origin; a Compute app signs requests to private buckets ([setup guide](https://www.backblaze.com/docs/cloud-storage-integrate-fastly-cdn-with-backblaze-b2)). Architecture: architectures/finish-package-deliver-generated-video/architecture.md
- [Telestream Vantage Gateway](https://www.telestream.net/): S3 custom endpoint. Source and destination use the NETAPP option with the B2 key ID, application key, S3 endpoint URL and bucket/path ([setup guide](https://www.backblaze.com/docs/cloud-storage-integrate-vantage-gateway-with-backblaze-b2)). Architecture: architectures/finish-package-deliver-generated-video/architecture.md
- [Mux Video](https://www.mux.com/): Presigned URLs. Pass a B2 presigned GET URL for the master as inputs[].url, with an expiry that covers Mux's download ([setup guide](https://www.mux.com/docs/api-reference/video/assets/create-asset)). Architecture: architectures/finish-package-deliver-generated-video/architecture.md

## Sample applications: closest workflow matches

- [Genblaze x GMICloud image-to-video pipeline](https://github.com/backblaze-labs/genblaze-gmicloud-pipeline): Generates an anchor image from a prompt, fans it out to several hosted image-to-video models, and writes every artifact plus a manifest to B2.
- [Genblaze multi-provider gen-media sample](https://github.com/backblaze-labs/genblaze-gen-media-multi-provider-sample): Builds a captioned explainer from one prompt (storyboard, keyframes, image-to-video, TTS, music, ffmpeg compose) with parent_run_id lineage on B2.
- [NVIDIA Nemotron x Genblaze](https://github.com/backblaze-labs/nvidia-nemotron-genblaze-b2): Turns uploaded media into a briefing, then generates images, speech, music and Cosmos video, all stored under run-ID prefixes in B2.
- [AI Avatar Video Generator](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/ai-avatar-video-generator): Generates talking-head video through a hosted API and archives each take to B2 before the provider URL expires.
- [Data-Juicer Multimodal Curation](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/data-juicer-multimodal-curation): Runs Data-Juicer recipes over raw shards and writes refined datasets, stats and configs back to B2; B2 I/O lives in the sample's app layer, not in Data-Juicer.
- [NudeNet Video Moderation](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/nudenet-video-moderation): Classifies sampled frames and writes flagged crops, reports and a violations manifest to B2, with a human review queue.
- [Remotion Promo Video Pipeline](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/remotion-promo-video-pipeline): Programmatic composition that stores storyboards, frames, MP4 cutdowns and manifests on B2, a pattern for assembling generated clips into per-platform cutdowns.
- [AI Shorts Generator](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/ai-shorts-generator): Turns one long video into 9:16 clips with burned-in captions (Whisper transcript, LLM moment selection, ffmpeg render), storing every source, transcript and clip on B2; a pattern for per-platform cutdowns of finished masters.
- [FFmpeg HLS VOD Transcoder](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/ffmpeg-hls-vod-transcoder): Builds an HLS ladder plus thumbnail sprites and WebVTT on B2.
- [Transloadit + bunny.net video sharing example](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/b2-transloadit-example): Uploads through Transloadit transcoding into a private B2 bucket, with delivery by bunny.net.

## Sample applications: operational building blocks

- [Genblaze SDK](https://github.com/backblaze-labs/genblaze): Multi-provider generative media pipeline SDK that saves outputs and SHA-256 provenance manifests to B2.
- [Comic Storyboard](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/comic-storyboard-b2): Generates character-consistent storyboard frames with per-frame SHA-256 manifests on B2, comparable to the keyframe stage before image-to-video.
- [ComfyUI Cloud Storage nodes](https://github.com/backblaze-labs/comfyui-cloud-storage): ComfyUI nodes with a Backblaze B2 preset that save video, load inputs, download models with an ETag cache, and generate presigned share URLs.
- [HF Cache Sync](https://github.com/backblaze-labs/hf-cache-sync): Syncs the Hugging Face hub cache to B2 so GPU nodes fetch large weights from B2 instead of the Hub.
- [Videohash Deduplication](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/videohash-deduplication): Perceptually hashes a video library on B2 and clusters near-duplicates.
- [CLIP Video Scene Search](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/clip-video-scene-search): Splits scenes with PySceneDetect, extracts keyframes, embeds them with OpenCLIP and builds an index, all persisted to B2.
- [Qwen Video Chapters](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/qwen-video-chapters): Runs a local Qwen2.5-VL model on keyframes and writes captions and summaries back to B2.
- [Pixeltable multimodal data notebooks](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/b2-pixeltable-multimodal-data): Notebooks that use Pixeltable with media stored in B2 for frame extraction and multimodal tables.
- [Whisper Subtitle Pipeline](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/whisper-subtitle-pipeline): Generates multilingual captions with faster-whisper and NLLB and stores them next to the source videos in B2.
- [WebDataset Streaming PyTorch Training](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/webdataset-streaming-pytorch-training): Streams tar shards from B2 into a PyTorch IterableDataset, split across nodes and workers.
- [LoRA Training Studio](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/lora-training-studio): Image LoRA training with Diffusers, with dataset, captions, checkpoints and safetensors versioned on B2; demonstrates the dataset and checkpoint storage layout used by the video-training architecture.
- [AI Video Upscaler & Restore](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/ai-video-upscaler-restore): Real-ESRGAN/GFPGAN upscaling and restoration, with sources and outputs kept side by side on B2.
- [RIFE Frame Interpolation Pipeline](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/rife-frame-interpolation-pipeline): 2x/4x/8x frame interpolation, with renders and manifests stored in B2.
- [Cloudflare Worker for B2](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/cloudflare-b2): Worker that signs requests to a private B2 bucket so it can be served only through Cloudflare.
- [Fastly Compute app for B2](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/fastly-b2-rust): Fastly Compute app that serves content from private B2 buckets.
- [B2 Event Broker](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/b2-event-broker): Cloudflare Worker that validates signed B2 Event Notifications and fans them out to subscribers.
- [Frame.io custom action for B2](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/backblaze-frameio): Bridge container that exports and imports assets between Frame.io and B2 for review.

## Sample applications: curated references

- [Awesome Video Generation](https://github.com/backblaze-labs/awesome-video-generation): Curated list of video generation APIs, open models, SDKs, infrastructure and evals.
- [Awesome Multimodal Data](https://github.com/backblaze-labs/awesome-multimodal-data): Curated list of multimodal datasets and data infrastructure (video, image, audio, 3D, robotics) with formats, loaders, versioning and labeling tools.
